context:
Goal: degen merges cost fewer runner minutes.
Problem (cost): each merge to main re-runs the suite on a tree the batch PR run proved, about 55 runner-min per merge (runner 11 audit). Runner 11 first checks degen's red-main check, so a red main is still caught.
Based on (ruling): claude-settings ci-once-per-batch (your 21:16 CST Nov 12).
Departs from: degen main, which runs the suite on every push — a skips it when the batch PR run proved the same tree.

options.how: degen skips the push-to-main suite after its red-main check is confirmed.
options.label: Skip it, like home (recommended)
options.lose: A tree changed after the batch run gets no second run on main.

options.gain: Main is proven by its own run.
options.how: degen keeps running it on every push.
options.label: Keep the suite on main

ref: coordinator 11:48 CST Nov 13, runner 11 child-repo CI audit
title: In degen, skip the full suite on push to main when the batch PR run already proved the same tree?
why: A CI change in another repo needs your word.
